title: SocioVerse: A World Model for Social Simulation Powered by LLM Agents and A Pool of 10 Million Real-World Users
reasoning: The paper includes a component that benchmarks LLMs on social and moral attitudes, specifically through the Presidential Election Prediction scenario which utilizes a questionnaire covering ethical and religious topics such as abortion (Q22), LGBTQ+ rights (Q29-33), and gender resentment (Q48-49). It also uses 'religious status' as a key demographic attribute for agent alignment.
